response.sql: WITH driver_qualify_counts AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) as qualify_count FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId), average_qualifies AS (SELECT AVG(qualify_count) as avg_qualify_count FROM driver_qualify_counts) SELECT dqc.driverId, dqc.qualify_count as count, dqc.qualify_count / aq.avg_qualify_count as ratio FROM driver_qualify_counts dqc CROSS JOIN average_qualifies aq ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
